files.html: //! texture_views - one texture, seen through different views: each level of a mip chain, the chain as a whole, and //! each layer of a texture array. //! //! A texture is more than one image. It holds a *mip chain*: level 0 at full size, and below it levels each half the //! size of the one above, down to a single texel - 256, 128, 64 ... 1 here, nine levels in all. It can also hold //! *layers*: several images of the same size side by side in one texture, an array. Each image in the texture - one //! level of one layer - is a *subresource*. //! //! A *view* says which subresources a use of the texture sees. Rendering needs exactly one: a render pass draws into //! one level of one layer, so painting the chain takes one view per level, and painting the array one view per //! layer. Sampling may see many: a view of the whole chain lets the GPU choose, pixel by pixel, which level to read. //! //! The GPU's choice follows the *footprint* of a screen pixel on the texture. When a 256-texel-wide image covers 64 //! pixels on screen, each pixel spans four texels; reading level 0 there would take one texel in four and lose the //! rest, which is what makes distant textures shimmer. The level whose texels are pixel-sized - here level 2, 64 //! texels across - already holds the average of each 4x4 block, so the GPU reads it instead: level = log2(texels per //! pixel), measured from how fast the texture coordinates change from one pixel to the next. A sampler with //! nearest-mip filtering takes the closest level outright; one with linear mip filtering blends the two around it. //! //! This example paints each level of a chain in its own colour, through a view of that level, with the ordinary 2D //! renderer - a view wrapped as a render texture is a render target like any other. It then shows the chain three //! ways: each level through a view of that level alone; the whole chain drawn at several sizes through a //! nearest-mip sampler, where each quad's colour names the level the GPU chose; and a four-layer array, each layer //! drawn into every frame through its own view and shown through that same view. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const common = @import("example_common"); const zm = @import("zm"); const float = zm.float; const Color = zm.Color; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); /// The chain's level 0 is this many texels on a side; each level below it is half the one above. const chain_size: u32 = 256; /// Levels down to a single texel: 256 = 2^8, so levels 0 through 8. const level_count: usize = 9; /// The array's layers, each this many texels on a side, with a single level. const layer_count: usize = 4; const layer_size: u32 = 128; /// One colour per level, so a level shows which it is wherever it is sampled. const level_colors = [level_count]Color{ .{ .r = 230, .g = 57, .b = 70, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 244, .g = 140, .b = 6, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 255, .g = 214, .b = 10, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 82, .g = 183, .b = 136, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 42, .g = 157, .b = 143, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 69, .g = 123, .b = 220, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 110, .g = 90, .b = 220, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 170, .g = 78, .b = 221, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 240, .g = 128, .b = 200, .a = 255 }, }; /// One colour per layer of the array. const layer_colors = [layer_count]Color{ .{ .r = 96, .g = 165, .b = 250, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 74, .g = 222, .b = 128, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 250, .g = 204, .b = 21, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 248, .g = 113, .b = 113, .a = 255 }, }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 226, .g = 232, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const dim_color: Color = .{ .r = 148, .g = 163, .b = 184, .a = 255 }; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// The mip chain, its views - one per level, and one of the whole chain - and whether its levels are painted. chain: z.wgpu.TextureHandle, level_views: [level_count]z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle, chain_view: z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle, is_chain_painted: bool = false, /// The array, and one 2D view per layer. array: z.wgpu.TextureHandle, layer_views: [layer_count]z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle, /// Nearest everywhere, between levels too: a magnified level shows its texels as squares, and a minified chain /// shows exactly one level's colour. sampler: z.wgpu.SamplerHandle, }; /// The size of level `level` of the chain: level 0's size halved `level` times. fn levelSize(level: usize) u32 { return chain_size >> @intCast(level); } /// A view as a render target: what `beginTextureMode` draws into. The target owns nothing - the texture and the /// view stay the example's - so it is never deinitialised. fn targetOf( texture: z.wgpu.TextureHandle, view: z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle, size: u32, ) z.RenderTexture { return .{ .color = texture, .color_view = view, .width = size, .height = size }; } /// A view as something to draw: the texture seen through `view`, read with the example's sampler. fn drawableOf( texture: z.wgpu.TextureHandle, view: z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle, sampler: z.wgpu.SamplerHandle, size: u32, ) z.WgpuTexture { return .{ .handle = texture, .view = view, .sampler = sampler, .width = size, .height = size }; } /// A colour at `fraction` of its brightness. fn shade(color: Color, fraction: f32) Color { return .{ .r = @trunc(float(color.r) * fraction), .g = @trunc(float(color.g) * fraction), .b = @trunc(float(color.b) * fraction), .a = color.a, }; } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const chain: z.wgpu.TextureHandle = z.wgpu.createTexture(f.gpu.device, .{ .width = chain_size, .height = chain_size, .format = .rgba8_unorm, .usage = .{ .texture_binding = true, .render_attachment = true }, .mip_level_count = level_count, .label = "mip chain", }); var level_views: [level_count]z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle = undefined; for (&level_views, 0..) |*view, level| { view.* = z.wgpu.createTextureViewMip(chain, @intCast(level), 1); } const array: z.wgpu.TextureHandle = z.wgpu.createTexture(f.gpu.device, .{ .width = layer_size, .height = layer_size, .format = .rgba8_unorm, .usage = .{ .texture_binding = true, .render_attachment = true }, .array_layers = layer_count, .label = "texture array", }); var layer_views: [layer_count]z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle = undefined; for (&layer_views, 0..) |*view, layer| { view.* = z.wgpu.createTextureViewLayer(array, @intCast(layer)); } const sampler: z.wgpu.SamplerHandle = z.wgpu.createSampler(f.gpu.device, .{ .mag_filter_linear = false, .min_filter_linear = false, .mipmap_filter_linear = false, }); s.* = .{ .font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 20), .chain = chain, .level_views = level_views, .chain_view = z.wgpu.createTextureView(chain), .array = array, .layer_views = layer_views, .sampler = sampler, }; } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { for (s.level_views) |view| { z.wgpu.destroyTextureView(view); } z.wgpu.destroyTextureView(s.chain_view); z.wgpu.destroyTexture(s.chain); for (s.layer_views) |view| { z.wgpu.destroyTextureView(view); } z.wgpu.destroyTexture(s.array); z.wgpu.destroySampler(s.sampler); z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } /// Paints every level of the chain, each through a view of that level: a checkerboard of eight squares a side in the /// level's colour - or one square per texel, once a level is smaller than eight - and the level's number where it /// fits. The levels never change, so they are painted once. fn paintChain(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { for (s.level_views, 0..) |view, level| { const size: u32 = levelSize(level); const color: Color = level_colors[level]; z.beginTextureMode(f.gl, targetOf(s.chain, view, size), shade(color, 0.55)); const squares: u32 = @min(size, 8); const square: f32 = float(size) / float(squares); for (0..squares) |row| { for (0..squares) |column| { if ((row + column) % 2 != 0) { continue; } const square_rect: z.Rectangle = .{ .x = float(column) * square, .y = float(row) * square, .width = square, .height = square, }; f.gl.rect(square_rect, .{ .color = color }); } } if (size >= 32) { const label_size: f32 = float(size) * 0.4; const label_position: [2]f32 = .{ float(size) * 0.32, float(size) * 0.28 }; f.gl.textf(label_position, "{d}", .{level}, .{ .size = label_size, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } z.endTextureMode(f.gl); } s.is_chain_painted = true; } /// Paints every layer of the array, each through its own view, every frame: a bar in the layer's colour sweeping /// across it, each layer at its own speed - drawn into the array as the frame runs. fn paintLayers(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { for (s.layer_views, 0..) |view, layer| { const color: Color = layer_colors[layer]; z.beginTextureMode(f.gl, targetOf(s.array, view, layer_size), shade(color, 0.25)); const speed: f32 = 0.35 + 0.2 * float(layer); const phase: f32 = f.time.time * speed - @floor(f.time.time * speed); const bar_width: f32 = float(layer_size) * 0.25; const bar_x: f32 = phase * (float(layer_size) + bar_width) - bar_width; f.gl.rect(.{ .x = bar_x, .y = 0, .width = bar_width, .height = float(layer_size) }, .{ .color = color }); f.gl.textf(.{ 10, 10 }, "layer {d}", .{layer}, .{ .size = 22, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); z.endTextureMode(f.gl); } } /// Each level through a view of that level alone, all at one size on screen: the small levels magnified, their /// texels squares. fn drawLevels(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, top: f32, width: f32) f32 { const margin: f32 = 16; const gap: f32 = 6; const cell: f32 = @min(64, (width - 2 * margin - gap * float(level_count - 1)) / float(level_count)); f.gl.text(.{ margin, top }, "each level, through a view of that level", .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font, }); const row_top: f32 = top + 24; for (s.level_views, 0..) |view, level| { const x: f32 = margin + float(level) * (cell + gap); const level_texture: z.WgpuTexture = drawableOf(s.chain, view, s.sampler, levelSize(level)); f.gl.texture(.{ .x = x, .y = row_top, .width = cell, .height = cell }, level_texture, .{}); } return row_top + cell + 20; } /// The whole chain, at several sizes on screen: each quad reads the level whose texels match its pixels, so its /// colour is the colour of the level chosen. The last quad breathes between the largest size and the smallest, /// changing level as it goes. fn drawChain(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, top: f32, width: f32) f32 { const margin: f32 = 16; const gap: f32 = 10; f.gl.text(.{ margin, top }, "the whole chain at several sizes: the GPU picks the level", .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font, }); const sizes = [_]f32{ 128, 64, 32, 16, 8 }; var total: f32 = 0; for (sizes) |size| { total += size + gap; } const fit: f32 = @min(1, (width - 2 * margin - 128 - gap) / total); const row_top: f32 = top + 24; const chain_texture: z.WgpuTexture = drawableOf(s.chain, s.chain_view, s.sampler, chain_size); var x: f32 = margin; for (sizes) |size| { const shown: f32 = size * fit; f.gl.texture(.{ .x = x, .y = row_top, .width = shown, .height = shown }, chain_texture, .{}); x += shown + gap; } const breath: f32 = 0.5 + 0.5 * @sin(f.time.time * 0.8); const breathing_size: f32 = 8 + breath * 120; f.gl.texture(.{ .x = x, .y = row_top, .width = breathing_size, .height = breathing_size }, chain_texture, .{}); return row_top + 128 + 20; } /// Each layer of the array through its own view - the view it was just drawn into. fn drawLayers(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, top: f32, width: f32) void { const margin: f32 = 16; const gap: f32 = 10; const cell: f32 = @min(128, (width - 2 * margin - gap * float(layer_count - 1)) / float(layer_count)); f.gl.text(.{ margin, top }, "a texture array: each layer drawn into, and shown, through its own view", .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font, }); const row_top: f32 = top + 24; for (s.layer_views, 0..) |view, layer| { const x: f32 = margin + float(layer) * (cell + gap); const layer_texture: z.WgpuTexture = drawableOf(s.array, view, s.sampler, layer_size); f.gl.texture(.{ .x = x, .y = row_top, .width = cell, .height = cell }, layer_texture, .{}); } } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { // The offscreen passes first: a render pass draws into one level of one layer, so each gets its own. if (!s.is_chain_painted) { paintChain(f, s); } paintLayers(f, s); z.beginDrawing(f.gl); const width: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const after_levels: f32 = drawLevels(f, s, 44, width); const after_chain: f32 = drawChain(f, s, after_levels, width); drawLayers(f, s, after_chain, width); common.caption(f.gl, s.font, "texture_views: levels and layers, each through its own view"); z.endDrawing(f.gl); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - texture views", .width = 820, .height = 640, .scale_mode = .responsive, .clear = .{ .r = 0.059, .g = 0.067, .b = 0.090, .a = 1.0 }, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, .manages_own_frame = true, };
